subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should built-in compaction drop aborted/error assistant tool-call turns before summarization, matching replay sanitizers, instead of synthesizing placeholder tool results for those failed turns?
rationale: The code path is narrow and well-tested, but choosing whether failed partial turns are omitted or represented in summaries is a session-state product policy that automation should not decide silently.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR with the explicit understanding that aborted/error assistant tool-call turns are removed from compaction input to keep strict-provider transcripts valid.

options.title: Require synthetic cancelled results
options.body: Ask for a revised patch that preserves failed turns as explicit cancelled/error tool results and proves strict-provider acceptance.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want a unified policy covering compaction, replay, durable repair, and future richer recovery metadata first.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR with the explicit understanding that aborted/error assistant tool-call turns are removed from compaction input to keep strict-provider transcripts valid.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently landed the adjacent Anthropic orphaned tool-use classifier and are already being routed in the PR discussion for this policy choice.
